ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly high-intensity white core; low-intensity black margins are present along the trailing and lateral edges; distinct low-intensity circular mottling clusters are localized in the left-mid lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 14% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) range from 5 to 22 pixels in depth relative to the edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature trajectory on both bilateral lobes extending from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular, high-contrast dark-on-white pixel clusters (approximately 5-7 distinct rings) located on the left lobe and smaller clusters on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal linear disruption (rake-like mark) of approximately 45 pixels in length located in the mid-right lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal linear scar on the right lobe; several circular scars and pitting clusters likely associated with historical barnacle colonization across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular pigmentation 'halos' or ring-shaped motifs concentrated on the mid-to-lower left lobe.
